name: XCC_BUDGET_DIST_ACCTS_HISTORY
description: This table contains budget distribution accounts that have been purged from the standard XCC_BUDGET_DIST_ACCTS table. This content must be saved for audit purposes, and can be archived to another storage location.

columns.name: AP_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Archive and purge process request identifier.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for the budget data stored in budgetary control.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number from the interface table.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period for which the budget is loaded.

columns.name: BUDGET_ACTION
columns.description: Indicates whether distribution account row is for balance initialization or adjustment.

columns.name: MASTER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of source control budget.

columns.name: FUNDS_RELEASED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which funds are released.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget amount for specific control budget, account, and period.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget impacted by this distribution.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Budget code combination identifier impacted by this distribution.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Data set identifier used by budgetary control engine for budget adjustments.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Original amount entered by user in the interface.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FOR_ESSBASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether balances have been transferred to the budget cube for this control budget and period name combination.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
